meta.title: Ambition Skills & Ability Test
meta.description: A detailed 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of healthy ambition skills and capacity.

levels.label: Highly Developed Healthy Ambition
levels.desc: Your ambition is purposeful, disciplined, adaptive, ethical, and strongly supported by sustainable habits.

levels.label: Strong Healthy Ambition
levels.desc: Most ambition-related habits are strong, with a few opportunities for greater consistency, reflection, or balance.

levels.label: Developing Ambition Capacity
levels.desc: Several useful foundations are present, though direction, discipline, resilience, feedback, or sustainability may vary.

levels.label: Emerging Ambition Capacity
levels.desc: Some purposeful drive is present, while clearer aims, practical planning, steady action, and healthier boundaries could help.

levels.label: Limited Current Ambition Capacity
levels.desc: Your current approach may be unclear, inconsistent, overly cautious, or unsustainable. Start with one meaningful goal and a manageable routine.

levels.label: Ambition Foundations Need Attention
levels.desc: Several foundations of healthy ambition appear limited right now. Build direction, agency, and sustainable action one step at a time.
